product.title: Cells of Time
product.description: In Cells of Time, you're the architect of a cellular world governed by the rules of Conway’s Game of Life. With just a few initial strokes, you shape the first generation—and then let time take over. Your challenge: design a pattern that will endure through 1,000 years of evolution... or maybe even longer.

history.text: Game developed in 3 hours for Trijam #321 (https://itch.io/jam/trijam-321). Theme: "1000 years"
The game was brought to life with C# and Blazor WebAssembly, powered by my own game engine, Blazorame!

quote.description: It is really a cool game and it was satisfying to watch it evolve after the drawing. Also it is a nice touch to have a high score table. Very well made, great job!

quote.description: Conway's game of life, it never gets old. I like the color palette that you chose, together with the musics, fonts, sounds, gives the game a whole new feel. And having a high score table is really great.
